issues.detail: Main calls17b a C5 diastereomer, but SI17 drawing also shifts exomethylene6=17 to endocyclic6=7 and labels17 asMe; source-drawn connectivity retained and C7 stereocenter absent. Requires independent review.
issues.subject: 17b source structure

issues.detail: 17->6 main90%then87% versus SI75%overall; Claisen-methylation mainNMP versus SIDMF; 21->22 main84%over2 versus SI96%then93% plus22a2%. SI event yields used.
issues.subject: yields and conditions

issues.detail: C13minor epimer in16/7 acknowledged but not separate unnamed isolated compounds; hydroboration15a mixture9/9-epi13 explicitly preserved.

issues.detail: Iodide10 drawn/coupled without local upstream preparation. Proposed failed S7–S10 and18a excluded as isolated compounds; failed screening outcomes retained here as source boundaries.
issues.subject: source boundaries

issues.detail: MainPDF4 reports no cytotoxicity of EupB itself up to20 micromolar in tested cells; IC50 values2.70/5.76 micromolar concern suppression of induced pyroptosis, not killing.
issues.subject: risk screen
